note: Health-emergency MoU consultation; states no rule on sending data out of Burundi.
Regional EAC framework under validation; states nothing about a Burundian rule or its use, only that member states' transfer rules differ.

facts.fact: Burundi Times says Article 15 of Burundi's data protection law requires countries receiving personal data from Burundi to give an adequate level of protection, and that transfers elsewhere are allowed with appropriate safeguards.
